narr: The stormy period which began on the 24th continued to bring severe weather and flash flooding through the end of the month.
ev: I-15 southbound was flooded near Littlefield.
Flash flooding closed numerous roads in and south of Golden Valley.
Temple Bar Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to mile marker 8.
Flash flooding closed numerous roads in and south of Golden Valley.

Numerous roads in and around Golden Valley were closed, and multiple water rescues took place. One fatality occurred when a truck overturned in a normally dry wash. The decedent was discovered several days later.
Castle Rock Rd was closed from Northern Ave to Swan Dr.
All the low water crossings over Short Creek were flooded and closed.
